video_title: ENCANTO: "Antonio's AMAZING Gift!" | Bedtime Story for Kids
description:
MIRABEL'S younger brother Antonio has an AMAZING 5th birthday gift that every kid would dream about!  In this magical story we will enter the enchanted world of ENCANTO through the wondrous miracle door!  Wait until you see Antonio's incredible dream gift! Let's go!!

This short Disney bedtime story is perfect for early readers. And this tale's breathtaking illustrations will magically transport the imagination to a whole new world of sweet dreams! This is one the kids will want to read/watch over and over!

This @Chazstories video is an ENCANTO Disney bedtime story for kids age 12 and under, one of hundreds of Disney bedtime stories for kids I read aloud to my grandkids. Subscribe to my channel if your kids/grandkids love Disney bedtime stories and more.

*A personal message from Chaz:* I'm a 70-year old grandfather of eight grandkids who live far away. I want to be a Mr. Rogers-type positive influence on my grandkids and everyone else. The bedtime stories I choose -- or don't choose -- reflect positive values like:

*Friendship* (Finding Nemo/Dory, Winnie the Pooh)

*Family* (Coco, Jungle Book, Encanto)

*Kindness* (Snow White, Cinderella)

*Love* (Princess stories, Anna and Elsa)

*Loyalty* (Winnie the Pooh characters, Mater)

*Goodness* (Mickey Mouse/Minnie Mouse stories)

*Patience* (Beauty and the Beast, Rabbit)

*Responsibility* (Princess Tiana, Judy Hopps/Zootopia)

*Courage* (Moana, Mulan, Jasmine)

*Honesty* (Pinocchio, Belle)

*Curiosity* (Little Einsteins)

As sleep stories, these are such healthy values for kids to fall asleep to and dream about. At my age there's a lot I can't do anymore. But I can do this.
